mainEntity.name: How much could I save by using a tax deduction expert?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on your situation, but many taxpayers find a specialist uncovers deductions worth thousands they had missed — from depreciation on an investment property to legitimately apportioned home-office costs. The matched agent reviews your specific situation and identifies what applies. The matching is free; you only pay the agent if you engage them.

mainEntity.name: What records do I need for deductions?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ATO requires substantiation for most deductions — receipts, invoices, logbooks, diary records. The matched agent will tell you exactly what to keep and for how long (typically five years). Some exceptions exist (e.g. laundry under $150, overtime meal claims) but documentation is the rule, not the exception.

mainEntity.name: Is the ATO really targeting deductions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — the ATO publishes occupation-specific guidance each year and uses data matching to flag claims outside normal ranges for your occupation. Over-claiming triggers audits and penalties. The matched agents ensure your claims are legitimate and substantiated so you claim the maximum you are entitled to without inviting scrutiny.

mainEntity.name: Can a deduction expert help with vehicle and travel claims?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matched agent advises on the logbook method vs cents-per-kilometre, ensures your logbook is current and compliant, and identifies all deductible work-related travel — so you claim the maximum you are entitled to without triggering an ATO review.

mainEntity.name: How quickly will a matched deduction expert contact me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most matches are completed within 60 seconds of finishing the questionnaire. Your matched firm will typically reach out within 2 hours, or you can call for immediate assistance to discuss your deductions.

mainEntity.name: Can a deduction expert help with investment property depreciation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Many property owners miss depreciation schedules — often worth thousands per year. The matched agent arranges a quantity surveyor's depreciation schedule if needed and ensures it is correctly claimed on your return.

mainEntity.name: Is matching free for deduction advice?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The matching service is free. We are engaged by the accounting firms in our network, not by you. You are under no obligation to proceed with any matched firm, and the matched agent gives you a clear quote before any work begins.

mainEntity.name: What if I've been over-claiming in past years?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tell us in the questionnaire. The matched agent can help lodge voluntary amendments for prior years, which often results in far better treatment than waiting for the ATO to discover the over-claim through data matching. Acting proactively demonstrates good faith.

blocks.heading: Tax Deduction Expert — what we can help with
blocks.text: SPECIALIST NETWORKTax Deduction Expert — what we can help withDeductions you may be missingMany taxpayers under-claim because they do not know what is deductible: work-from-home running costs, tools and equipment, union fees, self-education (if related to current income), vehicle use between work sites, donations, super contributions, income protection premiums, and the cost of managing tax affairs. Investment property owners often miss depreciation schedules. Our matched experts identify what applies to you.Industry-specific deductionsTradies claim vehicle and tool deductions differently to office workers, who claim differently again to medical professionals, who claim differently to rental-property owners. Our matching prioritises accountants experienced in your industry — so your deductions are claimed correctly and defensibly against an ATO review.Avoiding the 'red flag' riskOver-claiming is as costly as under-claiming. The ATO's 'hit list' targets specific occupations and deduction patterns each year. Our matched agents ensure your claims are legitimate, substantiated, and defensible — maximising your refund without triggering an audit, amended assessment, or penalty.
